title: # Housing conversation
text: This conversation focused on affordability and zoning trade-offs.

subContents.title: ### Housing
subContents.text: Participants discussed both affordability and neighborhood impact.

subContents.title: #### Affordable housing
subContents.text: People want more supply but also quality standards.

subContents.title: ##### themes
subContents.text:
- Build near transit
- Keep projects mixed-income

subContents.title: #### Zoning
subContents.text: The group debated trade-offs and implementation pace.

subContents.title: ##### themes
subContents.text:
- Preserve local character
- Pilot changes before scaling
